dashboard_items.title: Order Summary by Status
dashboard_items.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(total) as total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY total_amount DESC

dashboard_items.title: Customers
dashboard_items.query: SELECT customer_id, name, email, total_orders FROM customers ORDER BY total_orders DESC

dashboard_items.title: Orders for ${name}
dashboard_items.query: SELECT order_id, order_date, status, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = ${customer_id} ORDER BY order_date DESC

dashboard_items.title: Order Items Chart for ${name}
dashboard_items.query: SELECT li.product_name, SUM(li.quantity * li.unit_price) as total_spent FROM orders o JOIN line_items li ON o.order_id = li.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = ${customer_id} GROUP BY li.product_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC

dashboard_items.title: Line Items for Order #${order_id}
dashboard_items.query: SELECT line_item_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price, (quantity * unit_price) as total FROM line_items WHERE order_id = ${order_id}

dashboard_items.title: Product Details: ${product_name}
dashboard_items.query: SELECT product_id, description, category, supplier, stock_level FROM products WHERE product_name = '${product_name}'

dashboard_items.title: Supplier Info for ${product_name}
dashboard_items.query: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, contact_email, phone, address FROM suppliers WHERE supplier = '${supplier}'
